John writes about what he has seen, heard and touched. Why does it matter that the apostles were eyewitnesses?
God is light, and walking in the light gives fellowship with one another. What does walking in the light look like?
"If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us." What do you need to confess today?
Jesus is our advocate with the Father. What does it mean that Jesus speaks for you?
Whoever says he abides in Christ ought to walk as Jesus walked. How did Jesus walk?
Whoever loves his brother abides in the light. Is there someone you find hard to love?
John says do not love the world or the things in it. What worldly things pull at your heart?
"See what kind of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God." How does this make you feel?
John says love one another and not be like Cain. How does hatred begin, and how is it overcome?
Jesus laid down his life for us, so we should love in deed and truth. How could you love someone in action this week?
Even when our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart. Where do you need this assurance?
Test the spirits; he who is in you is greater than he who is in the world. How does this give you confidence?
"God is love." How has God shown his love to you?
"Perfect love casts out fear." What fear does God's love answer for you?
"We love because he first loved us." How does God's love help you love others?
Our faith is the victory that overcomes the world. What does that victory look like for you?
Whoever has the Son has life. What does it mean to have the Son?
John writes so that you may know you have eternal life. How sure are you of this?
John says to pray for a brother who sins, and keep yourselves from idols. What idols tempt you?
